recommendation: Strengthen prevention and early detection: sustain HPV vaccination uptake, and promote vulvar examination with biopsy of persistent lesions in primary care and gynecology, prioritising women in the highest-rate age band.
priority_stakeholders: ACOG / gynecologic oncology societies; HPV advocacy groups; NCI/SEER
supporting_evidence: CDC AAPC 1.41 (1.04 to 1.78) %/yr; segmented APC after breakpoint (2013.8): 2.70 (2.03 to 3.37) %/yr; mean AAMR 35-54 yrs = 0.22; mean AAMR 55-74 yrs = 1.25; mean AAMR 75+ yrs = 5.93
caveat: Vaccination effects on mortality are decades away; the AGE file has no under-35 band, so vaccine impact cannot be assessed here.

recommendation: Direct disparity-targeted funding, navigation and access programmes to the groups and regions with the highest mortality rate ratios; improve reporting for AI/AN and Asian/PI groups.
supporting_evidence: Non Metro vs Metro: RR 1.17 (1.13 to 1.21) (all years)
caveat: Rate ratios are ecological; Hispanic overlaps race; region SEs came from CIs; urbanization ends 2020.

recommendation: Plan supportive-care and end-of-life capacity (home, hospice, nursing facility) and maintain surveillance so that projections and place-of-death shifts are re-estimated as new WONDER years release.
priority_stakeholders: Policymakers; state health departments; palliative-care networks
supporting_evidence: largest place-of-death share change: Nursing home/long term care, -9.5 pp (Holm p = 5.29e-59); projected AAMR in 2040, Linear trend, 1999-2024: 1.67 (1.50-1.84); projected AAMR in 2040, Linear trend, post-Joinpoint 2014-2024: 2.07 (1.83-2.30); projected AAMR in 2040, ARIMA(0,1,0): 1.46 (1.06-1.86); projected AAMR in 2040, ETS: ETS(M,N,N): 1.46 (1.03-1.88)
caveat: Projections assume no change in screening, vaccination or practice; intervals are wide; use as planning scenarios only.
